how: Repeated calls recruit builders for starting, finishing, and defending the figures.
Explicit doubt about available hands makes a simpler design worth proposing.
Several members begin or propose pieces and ask others to join them.
Starting and recruiting can occur within one turn rather than forming successive stages.
A recruitment post receives a completion report and a renewed call, establishing a local call/build sequence without identifying individual placers.
Insufficient capacity prompts a simpler proposed design, but this concept does not establish a completed move after loss.
Design simplification, choosing which Thomas to build, and proposed facial details extend beyond border negotiation.
Partial and nearly finished figure reports describe the changing state of construction.
Coordinates locate the work without establishing an official template or a settled design.
A brief report identifies the Thomas attempt being worked on without requesting anything back.
A completion report can renew recruitment, and the brief assent follows an intervening turn, so neither warrants treating all replies as bare direct acceptance.
Recruiting includes directing builders into a separate chat whose decisions remain outside the visible record.
An invitation into an unseen coordination venue cannot establish whether participants decided roles or rules there.
Human reinforcement calls do not establish either machine placement or its absence.
Design discussion and coordinates do not show a template settling disagreement.
Repeated eye damage and defence priority keep completed work vulnerable and maintenance active.
A completion announcement receives a report of recurring damage to that figure.
Keeping existing work can include yielding another contested site instead of defending every image.
Keeping guest figures partly depends on maintaining their host's protective lattice and receiving its protection.
Members identify a taking-over image and offer a time-zone explanation without demonstrating individual responsibility or independently verified causation.
Maintenance strain leads to a stated need for outside help, while a turn to machine hands remains unobserved.
An approaching tribute prompts an explicit attempt to negotiate in the other room.
A visitor speaks for another room and a local participant carries the discussion into its thread.
Avoiding another image and proposing to yield a contested area make restraint visible without establishing treaty enforcement.
A requested permit, host placement advice, and host relocation with promised protection establish the candidate's local host/guest form.
Where a host relocates and protects guest figures, equal-neighbour border negotiation alone leaves the host/guest dependence unexplained.
Participants explicitly owe vandalism cleanup because they previously worked with the protective neighbour.
Other rooms announce help and participants report an outside community helping the build.
Explicit collaboration announcements and names for combined work establish joint work between rooms.
A chat invitation alone does not establish coalition membership, which requires the separate joint-work evidence.
A defence-related request for outside help receives a reply reporting help already being supplied.
A defence-related help request can draw on collaboration announced earlier rather than demonstrate that strain created the coalition.
Anticipated consumption prompts a permit request while construction is incomplete, so negotiation need not follow a separate completed upkeep stage.
A personal recommendation to yield after attempted negotiation does not establish restraint caused by a settled border.
Prior work explicitly explains reciprocal cleanup, but the record does not establish a border agreement as the channel's cause.
An aborted site and a host's successful rearrangement do not establish a room-wide move caused by erasure or insufficient hands.
A permit request and attempted deal do not disclose dispute over who can bind the placers.
Visible negotiation does not show a subsequent dispute over representative authority.
Calls to fellow robots and proposals for familiar facial details carry ordinary fandom into the build.
The named neighbouring room approaches through current canvas plans rather than an evidenced inherited quarrel.
Fake tour announcements are circulated, recognised as a yearly joke, and answered with warnings and admissions of almost being fooled.
A megathread and a further redirection contain canvas posts under an explicit tidiness rationale.
Calls precede containment and tidiness is explicit, but the concepts do not independently establish a flood complaint or moderator enforcement.
Repeated completion announcements, praise, and thanks mark milestones and the collective effort.
Celebrating a completed figure gives participants a shared achievement to mark before they call for the next figure.
Celebrating the full first figure is answered by starting the second figure, reopening design and building within the same effort.
An end-of-event report records that the pixel art was protected until closure.
Celebration precedes the closure report, but the concepts do not establish that celebration prompted preservation.
A member reports making Thomas again on a replacement canvas after the original event ended.
An individual remake cannot establish a decision by the whole room to migrate or collectively continue.
A replacement-canvas report follows the closure record without attributing the remake to that record.
A pre-close alteration proposal and a later remake report do not show post-close contest over a shared historical version.
Incoming covering and griefing establish threats to the room's work without establishing an outgoing attack.
Naming the taking-over image does not establish rival-directed taunts or victory talk.
Current neighbour encroachment does not establish an inherited tie naming an attack target.
Recruitment and reinforcement calls do not disclose a turn toward an outgoing attack.
A recommendation to yield does not establish refusal of an evidenced local attack call.
Negotiation over incoming encroachment does not establish negotiation responding to this room's outgoing attack.
A takeover report does not establish an outgoing attack followed by a discursive rivalry.
A pride-filled report of four hours spent making a figure marks personal labour inside the recruitment theme rather than issuing another call.
